routes.name: Work and employment visa
routes.summary: A visa for non-EU/EEA workers with a job offer in Spain. The employer usually starts the process in Spain. Language requirement not yet verified - check the official site.
eligibility: You have a job offer or employment contract in Spain
Your employer files the initial application with Spanish authorities
You hold a passport valid for the planned stay
You have no criminal record from countries you lived in (document rules not yet verified)
No language level is listed because it has not been verified yet - check the official site

routes.name: Non-lucrative residence visa
routes.summary: A residence visa for people who want to live in Spain without working there, showing their own financial means. Required income figures are not yet verified - check the official site.
eligibility: You can prove sufficient financial means to support yourself (amount not yet verified)
You have private health insurance with an authorised insurer
You hold a passport valid for the planned stay
You have no criminal record from countries you lived in (document rules not yet verified)

routes.name: Student residence visa
routes.summary: A visa for full-time studies at an accredited institution in Spain. Language requirement for your course is not yet verified - check the official site.
eligibility: You have an admission or enrolment letter from an accredited institution
You can show you can cover your living costs (amount not yet verified)
You hold a passport valid for the planned stay
You have health insurance cover for Spain
